



Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information
Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. "1  +, 1  +"
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"
Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan

"01   ' 5 "
"Step Out From the Old to the New"
Jawaharlal Nehru
